elements_not_encoded.reason: Hb has no unit or observable in the language; the rule fires less often than the page intends (Hb < 7 alone does not trigger it).

elements_not_encoded.text: If hock2/systolic BP < 80, give sodium chloride 0.9% 500mL IV over 30 minutes, repeat until systolic BP > 90. Continue 1L 6 hourly. Stop if breathing worsens.
Test for malaria with rapid test3 if available.
elements_not_encoded.reason: Rapid test is a management step; test results have no observable.

elements_not_encoded.text: If positive, give artesunate 2.4mg/kg IM before referral. Indicate dose and route in referral letter.
If referral delayed, give second dose artesunate 2.4mg/kg IM 12 hours later. Notify4 within 24 hours.

judgment_calls.decision: History of travel with high risk of exposure to communicable disease (situation), onset within 3 months
judgment_calls.alternatives: No concept for residence in/visit to a malaria area; leaving it out would make every febrile patient 'suspected malaria'

judgment_calls.decision: Task 'Check for exposure to a malaria area' fires on any recorded page symptom (temp ≥ 38, headache, fatigue, muscle pain, cough, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea) and also asks about severe headache, shivering, joint pain, flu-like illness, dry cough
judgment_calls.alternatives: No task (the travel finding would never be asked for)

judgment_calls.decision: 'presents with' list read as any one of the symptoms; 'nausea and vomiting' as both together, 'or diarrhoea' alone
Possible Complicated malaria with the same evidence as the urgent rule
Shock (disorder) or SBP < 80 as on the red box; footnote 2 not built into a shock rule
